notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS (B2B product analytics) exploring embeddings + semantic search to power in-app help, product discovery, and surfacing similar customer journeys.
- Starting with Redwood Hosted API POC to validate throughput, embedding quality vs Pinecone+OpenAI baseline; plan to move to Dedicated if cost/latency predictability favorable.
Technical requirements / asks:
- Vector DB: currently using Pinecone for index store; want Redwood to integrate with existing Pinecone workflow and batch ingestion. Need guidance for connector pattern.
- Throughput: peak embedding creation during nightly batch: ~2M documents/month -> plan daily batch windows; expect batch throughput ~150k embeddings/hour during job window.
- Online query QPS: semantic search read path target 120 QPS steady-state for customer-facing search (95th latency target < 120ms for topK retrieval + scoring). Internal admin workflows require <50ms latency for ranked results.
- Batch jobs: need retry/resume, idempotency keys, ability to parallelize across shards. Looking for Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization profiles to reduce cost.
- Model preference: prefer an open/quantized LLM (Llama-2 / Mistral family) or Redwood-verified equivalents; want deterministic embedding vectors and model-version pinning.
- Security: SOC2 mandatory for procurement; SSO/SAML integration with Okta; KMS/HSM for key management; audit logging and 1-year retention for logs; data residency US-only.
POC scope & success metrics:
- Run Hosted API POC for 2 weeks producing embeddings for representative sample (200k docs). Compare: recall@10, latency p95, ingestion throughput, RU/cost per 1k embeddings.
- Instrument metrics: token cost, per-request latency, embedding size, per-search end-to-end latency including vector DB lookups.
- If Hosted meets 80% of SLA/cost goals, propose Dedicated pilot for steady traffic and VPC connectivity.
Conversation snippets & quotes:
- "We need to avoid a surprise 10x bill during batch jobs" — Head of Engineering.
- "If Dedicated gives predictable unit economics and VPC, we will move faster on contract" — VP Product.
Recent timeline (high level):
- 2025-01-15: Account created from inbound product trial sign-up.
- 2025-01-22: Discovery call (Riley + Marco) — high-level architecture, pain points. (ff_2025-01-22_peregrine_discussion)
- 2025-01-28: Security questionnaire sent, asked for SOC2 + KMS details.
- 2025-02-05: Demo: Hosted API embeddings + simple semantic search flow. Team liked streaming logs & token breakdowns.
- 2025-02-12: POC kickoff call — defined sample dataset (200k docs) and batch ingestion window. (ff_2025-02-12_poc-kickoff)
- 2025-02-18: Initial Hosted API run completed for 20k sample; preliminary recall similar to Pinecone baseline but cost higher for naive config.
- 2025-02-20: Pricing follow-up exchanged; Redwood provided batching and quantization config suggestions.
Open items & blockers:
- Security team still needs KMS/HSM architecture diagram and SOC2 report copy (SEC-4421).
- Legal requested reseller language for Dedicated purchase order.
- Need clearer Dedicated sizing guidance (GPU types, concurrency, expected tokens/sec) to finalize ARR estimate.
Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver Dedicated sizing draft and cost model by 2025-02-25 (Marco).
- Customer to run full 2-week Hosted API POC on 200k subset starting 2025-02-26.
- Legal to exchange T&Cs for mid-market pilot; discuss 60-day early-termination for pilot.
Stability notes / other context:
- Tech stack: Go backend, AWS EKS, event-driven ingestion (Kafka), current vector store Pinecone; looking to keep Pinecone for index storage initially.
- Data classification: PII-lite (hashed IDs + metadata), high concern around residency and auditability.
- Internal champions: VP Product (sponsor), Head of Eng (technical buyer), Data Platform lead (operational owner).
